title: Boolean-Mobius greedy reduction: Mersenne gap dominance and unique half-target words

concepts.label: local Mersenne gap dominance
concepts.note: Every quotient weight exceeds its complete lower tail by the parity-uniform binary window.

concepts.label: below-gap greedy uniqueness
concepts.note: An admissible Boolean word with defect below a separating gap is the deterministic integer-greedy word.

concepts.label: half-target lower-word canonicalisation
concepts.note: The local Mersenne half target specializes the abstract unique-window hinge.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONCRETE DOMINANCE: if R <= M and 1 <= d, then the quotient-weight list localMersenneWeightsFrom M R d is recursively gap-dominated by lowerBinaryWindow M R = 2^(M-R); every head exceeds its complete remaining tail by at least that window.
statement_nodes.engine: Quotient-floor bounds, the finite Mersenne-tail estimate, positivity of the Mersenne correction beyond the first omitted dyadic harmonic, and recursion down the weight list.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Concrete project-specific instantiation of a superincreasing-word argument; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Gap dominance supplies separation only. It does not prove that a greedy remainder lies below the window, that an exact half-target word exists, or that the remaining repair load is safe.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED ABSTRACT UNIQUE-WINDOW HINGE: for a positive gap, a gap-dominating weight list, an equal-length Boolean word, and an admissible target C, the defect C - weightedBoolSum weights bits is below the gap iff bits is exactly integerGreedyBits weights C and the deterministic greedy remainder is itself below the gap.
statement_nodes.engine: Gap separation of distinct Boolean sums plus maximality and admissibility of the descending greedy word.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The paper identifies the superincreasing-word plus below-gap uniqueness technique as standard and fully general.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The right side retains the greedy-remainder inequality. Gap dominance alone does not put that remainder inside the window, and the theorem does not assert existence of a below-gap representative.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED HALF-TARGET SPECIALISATION: if R <= M, bits has the local Mersenne weight-list length, weightedBoolSum (localMersenneWeights M R) bits + A = 2^(M-1)-1, and A < lowerBinaryWindow M R, then bits is the deterministic integer-greedy word for the half target and A equals its integer-greedy remainder.
statement_nodes.engine: The concrete Mersenne gap-dominance theorem followed by the abstract below-gap uniqueness reduction.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Direct specialization of the general unique-window hinge to the local half target.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The exact-fill and inside-window statements are theorem inputs, not outputs. The theorem canonicalises any such construction but produces neither the construction nor a uniform small-remainder or repair-load theorem.

intra_zone_relations.basis: Instantiate the abstract target with 2^(M-1)-1 and the weights with localMersenneWeights M R, then identify the defect with A using the exact-fill equation.
The concrete Mersenne dominance theorem discharges the abstract GapDominates premise needed for unique-window canonicalisation.
The concrete theorem proves that Mersenne lists have the required separation, while the abstract theorem explains what any below-gap admissible representative must be.
